seo.title: Editions | Veylune Studio
seo.description: Limited releases, atelier collaborations, material studies, and private previews within the Veylune collection system.

hero.title: A governed release layer for collectible works.
hero.text: Editions bring selected furniture, lighting, and objects into controlled release contexts shaped by material logic, atelier collaboration, spatial relevance, and archive continuity.

governance.title: Editions are release records, not campaign pages.
governance.text: Each Edition defines why selected works belong together. A piece may remain part of Seating, Lighting, or Objects while the Edition records its release context, supplier collaboration, material study, or private preview status.

crossCollection.title: Cross-collection placement
crossCollection.text: Editions can connect Seating, Lighting, and Objects without replacing the primary collection structure.

releaseContext.title: Editorial release context
releaseContext.text: A release is defined by material, spatial, supplier, or small-series logic rather than promotion.

archiveContinuity.title: Archive continuity
archiveContinuity.text: Edition records remain useful after active availability changes.

releaseTypes.title: Five controlled formats define how Editions enter the platform.

atelierCollaboration.title: Atelier Collaboration
atelierCollaboration.text: A supplier or studio release prepared through Veylune collection and editorial standards.

materialStudy.title: Material Study
materialStudy.text: A release organized around material clarity, finish, and spatial use.

roomEdition.title: Room Edition
roomEdition.text: A release framed by architectural interior context and room logic.

smallSeries.title: Small Series
smallSeries.text: A controlled production group presented only when availability is operationally clear.

privatePreview.title: Private Preview
privatePreview.text: A restrained inquiry path for works reviewed before wider publication.

supplier.title: Editions provide a controlled context for selected collaborators.
supplier.text: Supplier participation is handled through collection fit, material clarity, production readiness, and architectural relevance. Editions do not function as vendor pages or supplier directories.

acquisition.title: Edition inquiries are handled through consultation.
acquisition.text: Veylune uses a calm inquiry path for Editions so clients, architects, and interior professionals can discuss release context, availability, and project fit without pressure mechanics.

seo.title: Atelier Partnerships | Veylune Studio
seo.description: A curated partnership path for ateliers, studios, and makers working across collectible furniture, lighting, objects, and refined interiors.

hero.label: Atelier Partnerships
hero.title: A curated path for ateliers with material discipline and spatial intention.
hero.text: VEYLUNE works with selected makers, studios, and design manufacturers whose pieces can live inside a controlled editorial-commerce environment.

philosophy.title: We protect context, presentation, and the long-term value of a coherent design world.
philosophy.panelTitle: Partnership begins with alignment, not volume.
philosophy.panelText: VEYLUNE is built for objects that deserve editorial structure: pieces with proportion, material presence, and a clear place inside refined interiors.

curation.title: Veylune is interested in work that can hold a room with restraint.

furniture.title: Collectible Furniture
furniture.text: Seating, tables, storage, and room-defining forms with strong proportion and material clarity.

lighting.title: Architectural Lighting
lighting.text: Floor, wall, table, and pendant lights with controlled illumination and spatial presence.

objects.title: Objects & Vessels
objects.text: Material-led objects whose scale, surface, and silhouette contribute to an interior composition.

editions.title: Interior Editions
editions.text: Small series, atelier releases, and pieces suited to long-term collection building.

standards.title: Products are prepared as collection entries, not marketplace listings.

context.title: Product Context
context.text: Each piece is placed within collection logic, room relevance, material vocabulary, and long-term brand coherence.

governance.title: Story Governance
governance.text: Native description, properties, and Veylune storytelling fields are handled as separate editorial layers.

visualDiscipline.title: Visual Discipline
visualDiscipline.text: Media should show form, scale, surface, and atmosphere without lifestyle clutter or decorative excess.

bilingualReadiness.title: Bilingual Readiness
bilingualReadiness.text: English and German content are managed with language-strict storytelling to avoid fallback leakage.

fit.title: We review partners through design integrity, operational clarity, and presentation readiness.
